character_types: bearded tough guy in hooded coat
visual_synopsis: Two young men sit side by side in a wooden-panelled cinema hall with tip-up seats, talking and gesturing to each other for most of the sketch while a few spectators sit in the row behind them. Cut-ins show a bearded man in a black hooded coat sitting alone in the empty rows; one of the pair walks up the aisle past him, the bearded man grabs him by the collar in the corridor, and afterwards the two are seen talking in the seats before the hall goes dark.
